think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range. 2) Check documentation for sentinel values (e.g., 0, -1) that change the knob’s meaning to a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior), rather than just being a smaller/larger numeric setting. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
